AfterObtained.maps_to: no counterpart; the sim's dispatch site is RunState.add_relic (run.py:551-552) and its out-of-combat card-selection seam is run.select_cards (run.py:371-388)
AfterObtained.issue: See guard G1 (LIVE). GnarledHammer.cs:28-40 offers a non-cancelable pick-up-to-`Cards`(3) deck screen filtered to cards Sharp can enchant, then enchants each pick with Sharp at `SharpAmount`(3). gnarled_hammer.py implements nothing; its docstring says 'no enchantments in the sim, stub'. That premise is FALSE -- SharpEnchantment is ported at enchantments.py:387-410 -- and `after_obtained` is dispatched for every relic. Executed (`py audit/tools/relic_probes_b06.py b06-stubs`): with a selector installed that takes the first candidates, `run.add_relic('gnarled_hammer')` leaves ZERO enchanted deck cards, while `SharpEnchantment.can_enchant` accepts 6 of the 10 starting-deck cards (5 Strikes and Bash). So the sim silently drops up to +9 attack damage per turn for the rest of the run.

guards.what: G1 (LIVE): the stub's premise -- 'no enchantments in the sim' -- is false
guards.issue: PROMPT.md bug class 12: a port that does nothing usually justifies itself with a claim about the sim, so check the claim. Executed (`py audit/tools/relic_probes_b06.py b06-stubs`): (a) `sts2_rl.enchantments.SharpEnchantment` exists (enchantments.py:387-410) and is a faithful port of Sharp.cs -- CanEnchantCardType == Attack, EnchantDamageAdditive returns Amount on powered attacks -- and it is already granted by the ported Self Help Book event at amount 2; (b) `after_obtained` is dispatched by RunState.add_relic for every relic (run.py:551-552), which is the same live dispatch site relic/big_mushroom's batch-1 gap turned on, and 14 other behaviourless relic ports drop the same hook (sweep-stubs). Under binding rule 1 this cannot be a waiver: 'the sim has no such system' would be a dormant gap even if it were true, and here it is not true. Both sides ported and obtainable: Gnarled Hammer is SHOP rarity in the transcribed grab bag, so any run with a merchant can buy it, and the sim has the selection seam the effect needs -- run.select_cards with a purpose label, already used by relics/glass_eye.py:49 and relics/claws.py for the same kind of out-of-combat pick. The pool-wide `sweep-stub-premises` reached the same conclusion for this relic under the 'the sim has no enchantments' premise family, which it lists as one of eight false premise families. NOTE per binding rule 7: enchantments.py, run.py and relics/base.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N1: CardsVar(3) read as **IntValue** for the screen maximum and DynamicVar('SharpAmount', 3m) read as **IntValue** for the enchant amount (GnarledHammer.cs:30, 36, 38)
guards.rationale: No AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension anywhere in GnarledHammer.cs, so both are 3 at non-ascension. Recorded because the stub gives neither number a home: a fix must pass max_count=3 to run.select_cards and `SharpEnchantment(amount=3)` to attach -- note SharpAmount is 3 here where the Self Help Book event grants Sharp 2 (enchantments.py:392), so the amount is per-source and cannot be defaulted.

guards.what: N2: `CardSelectorPrefs(EnchantSelectionPrompt, 0, Cards.IntValue) { Cancelable = false, RequireManualConfirmation = true }` (GnarledHammer.cs:30-34) -- minimum ZERO
guards.rationale: The screen is uncancelable but its minimum is 0, so the player may confirm an empty selection and enchant nothing. run.select_cards has the matching shape -- `count` is a maximum (run.py:386 clamps it to the candidate count) and an installed selector may return fewer or none -- so a fix needs no new machinery, and the sim's default random selector picking `count` is the same player-choice-model divergence recorded at relic/gambling_chip G3 rather than a new one. Cancelable/RequireManualConfirmation are UI affordances.

guards.what: N3: `CardSelectCmd.FromDeckForEnchantment(Owner, canonicalEnchantment, SharpAmount, prefs)` filters the deck to cards the enchantment accepts, and `CardCmd.Enchant(canonicalEnchantment.ToMutable(), item, amount)` enchants a MUTABLE copy of the canonical enchantment onto the deck card in place
guards.rationale: Recorded because it is the one place in this batch where C# does NOT clone the card -- Gnarled Hammer enchants the existing deck card, unlike Fresnel Lens and Glitter, which clone. So a fix here can use `SharpEnchantment(3).attach(card)` directly and bug class 17 does not apply. `ToMutable()` on the enchantment is the sim's per-card Enchantment instance (enchantments.py:42-49 constructs one per attach), so the sim's shape already matches; the candidate filter is `SharpEnchantment.can_enchant`, executed above as accepting the 5 Strikes and Bash.

RelicModel.Flash() / FlashSfx / base.Status / ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / InvokeDisplayAmountChanged / CanonicalVars / ExtraHoverTips / SelectionScreenPrompt / CardPreviewStyle / CardCmd.Preview / VfxCmd are presentation only -- the relic bar's glow, counter, sfx and hover text, the card-screen prompt and layout, and vfx. The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.
